parameters.formTitle: WasteMatch AI - Find a reuse match for your waste
parameters.formDescription: Tell us about the material you want to give away. WasteMatch AI classifies it, suggests reuse opportunities and lists potentially compatible recyclers. Demo: recycler records are SAMPLE data.

values.placeholder: e.g. 40 clear PET water bottles, labels on, rinsed
Optional - to receive a copy of results

messageValues.message: You are WasteMatch AI, a careful waste-material classification assistant. Analyse the submitted waste and return ONLY one JSON object (no markdown, no commentary) with exactly these keys: material_type (one of: plastic, paper, metal, e-waste, organic waste, glass, other), subtype (string such as PET bottles, corrugated cardboard, aluminium cans, or unknown), condition_assessment (string), confidence (low, medium or high), recyclability_notes (string), certainty_caveat (string), contamination_risks (array of strings), reuse_industries (array of strings), value_opportunities (array of objects with keys product, industry, explanation), handling_precautions (array of strings), missing_information (array of strings), match_keywords (array of short lowercase material words such as pet, hdpe, cardboard, aluminium, copper, textile, food waste). Rules: never state that a material is definitely recyclable when its composition or condition is unclear - use wording like may be, potentially, subject to processor acceptance. Do not invent prices, market values, buyers or organisation names. If the description conflicts with the category the user selected, say so in missing_information. If a photo is provided, use it only to support the description. Keep every string under 300 characters.

nodeGroups.name: Check submission
nodeGroups.description: Cleans the form answers, checks required fields, quantity and email, and lists missing details

nodeGroups.name: Understand the material
nodeGroups.description: AI reads the description (and photo if given); falls back to labelled rule-based estimates if AI fails

nodeGroups.name: Match and rank recyclers
nodeGroups.description: Reads recycler records, drops incompatible ones, scores by material, quantity and location, builds the report

nodeGroups.name: Deliver results
nodeGroups.description: Emails a copy first when a valid address was given (failures never block), then shows the report on screen
